purpose: Input feasibility only; no stock rankings or returns
provider: Open Source Asset Pricing, Chen and Zimmermann (2022), Critical Finance Review 11(2), 207–264
data_license: CC BY 4.0, as stated by the provider's dataset card
source_hash_note: Provider-file hash from earlier metadata record; this column-selective read did not recompute a full-file hash.
method: Read unsigned permno, yyyymm and CBOperProf columns with fsspec and pyarrow from the pinned Parquet revision; select permno 12490 and months 202403 and 202404. Floats printed to 15 decimal places.
limitations: The IBM identifier is a historical lead; security identity for these months is not independently established.
Provider states signals are usable at month-end; actual availability, filing revisions, calculation semantics and code-to-release binding are not independently established.
The April month-end observation follows the April 29 pilot cutoff and is not eligible for that cutoff.
No comparison against SEC inputs, price, market equity, NYSE universe, signal ranks or returns was performed.
